questions.stem: If the perimeter of a rectangle is 2(l + b) and l = 3x + 2, b = x - 1, what is the perimeter?

hint.level_0: The sides are algebraic expressions. Perimeter still means: add ALL the sides around the shape.
hint.level_1: A rectangle has two lengths and two breadths, so each expression is used twice.
hint.level_2: Perimeter = 2 × (length + breadth) — add the two expressions inside the bracket first, then double = ?
